yt_title: How to find a reel you watched but didn't save
caption:
You watched it. Never saved it.

Instagram saved reels stay put. Watched ones are harder: check Watch history in Your activity.

For your saves: download your Instagram data, tick only Saved, drop the zip into SaveSort. Runs in your browser, nothing uploaded.

Sort yours free, link in bio.

Sorty's voice is AI. Our sample report (156 saves) is real.
